name: Jougasaki Mizuki
source:
At first glance, she looks like "weirdo," but her supermodel-like looks neutralizes the "weirdo" part. Despite her appearances she is a very good principal and is loved by all teachers, students and anyone else involved with her because she treats everyone with kindness and respect.

She also has a laissez-faire attitude, and tends to let things happen as long as they do not become a problem. Although it is difficult for people to understand her policies, she cares about her students. She always does her best to protect the school and its students by eliminating any negative influences.

She is also a rare "multi ability master". She has the ability to take the abilities of others and use them herself. It is by no exaggeration that she is the most powerful person in the world. It is also by coincidence that she saved Mihara Aika from her abilities going out of control.

Whilst being extremely beautiful with an eccentric style of fashion, she can be a little self-conscious. She has thick lips and looks at people with a sense of flirtation.

P/A: Deprive

Hobbies: It's a secret
Special skill: Confidential
Likes: Likes what she likes
Dislikes: Dislikes what she dislikes
